# RewriteDEX fork: vendored from upstream scrcpy v4.1 meson_options.txt.
# Must sit next to meson.build for meson's `option()` lookups to resolve.
# Upstream uses type='boolean' (NOT 'feature') because the v4l2/usb guards
# are simple truthiness checks (`get_option('v4l2') and host_machine...`).
# FeatureOptionHolder does NOT support bool() coercion — must be boolean.
option('v4l2', type : 'boolean', value : false)
option('usb', type : 'boolean', value : false)
option('static', type : 'boolean', value : false)
option('portable', type : 'boolean', value : false)
option('server_debugger', type : 'boolean', value : false)
